# Workflow Automation

Wexpro Labs turns repetitive computer tasks into reusable AI helpers for solo owners, founders, operators, finance leads, admin teams, and service businesses.

## What it does

- A person shows Wexpro Labs a task once.
- The task becomes a reusable helper that can click, type, copy, paste, upload, download, compare, and check work across existing tools.
- The helper can pause for review before important or risky actions.
- Runs leave logs and screenshots so owners and operators can see what happened.

## Best fit

- Repeated tasks across portals, spreadsheets, emails, PDFs, dashboards, CRMs, ERPs, or older business tools.
- Tasks that happen daily, weekly, or whenever a customer, invoice, order, vendor, report, case, or document appears.
- Tasks that start messy but still follow a recognizable pattern.
- Tasks where saving time matters more than building custom software from scratch.

## Probably not worth automating

- One-off tasks that will not happen again.
- Tasks that take only a minute and do not block better work.
- Tasks that change completely every time.
- Tasks that depend almost entirely on personal judgment, negotiation, taste, or sensitive decisions.
- Risky actions such as payments, legal filings, payroll changes, or account shutdowns without human review.
